transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Yeah, hi. Um... I don't really know how to explain it. I just... I keep getting these thoughts. 

I drive a taxi, and... well, even when I know I did the safety check on the cab, this thought just keeps hitting me that I missed something. Like, that somebody could get hurt, or my boss is gonna say I lied about checking it. And... I don't know, I just can't make it shut up. It happens a lot when I'm driving, or... or when I'm trying to study.
When you have these thoughts, do you find yourself doing something over and over—like checking things again, counting, or trying to neutralize the thought in some way?

Yeah... I guess I do. Um... before I can take a ride, I just... I keep going around the car. Checking the tires, the lights... the doors. The meter and the paperwork inside. Just... over and over. 

Sometimes I even take pictures of them. If it doesn't feel right, I... I have to restart the whole check. It's... yeah. I do it even when passengers are standing right there waiting and I'm already late. I just... I have to do it.
When you have those thoughts, does it make you feel anxious or upset if you try to stop yourself from checking or doing the rituals?
Yeah... um, I don't really try to stop. I just... I just do it. It's too hard not to.
Do these thoughts feel like they don’t belong to you or that they go against what you believe or want, making them especially upsetting when they come up?

Um... I don't know if they don't belong to me. It's just... like I said before, I know I already did the safety check. But the thought just keeps hitting me anyway. 

That I missed something and... someone's gonna get hurt, or my boss will say I lied. I don't want to think about it. I just... I can't make it shut up.
Do you feel like you have to do these checks in order to prevent something bad from happening, like someone getting hurt or your boss getting angry?

Yeah... I guess so. That's... that's why I do all that stuff I mentioned before. Going around the car, checking the tires and the doors and the paperwork over and over. Taking the pictures. 

I just... I feel like I have to do all that to make sure it's safe. Even if the passengers are just standing there waiting and I'm already late... I just have to do the whole check, or restart it if it feels wrong, just so... so nothing bad happens.
